sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹10L mentioned as minimum for Endless SI option)

room_rent.note: Room rent limit is specified in the Policy Schedule; actuals/single private AC/twin sharing can be opted via Section 9.1 modifier. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU expenses covered under In-Patient Treatment; proportionate deduction does not apply to ICU. Specific limit per Policy Schedule.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Voluntary Co-Payment (Section 10.2) can be opted for a premium discount; percentage as per Policy Schedule.

sub_limits.note: Policy wording references sub-limits specified in the Policy Schedule for various benefits (room rent, domiciliary, ambulance, maternity, etc.). Specific disease sub-limits not enumerated in wording itself.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan. Voluntary Deductible (Section 10.1) — annual aggregate or per-claim — can be opted for a premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents or if continuously covered for 12+ months.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 24 months. Can be changed (reduced) via optional Section 9.3 modifier for additional premium.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed specific diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) have 24-month waiting period. Reducible to 12 months via optional Section 9.2 modifier.

maternity.note: Maternity & Child Care Cover (Section 3.3) is an optional cover available with Section 3. 24-month waiting period applies; limit as per Policy Schedule; max 2 deliveries; OPD pre/post-natal up to ₹10,000. Waiting period reducible via Section 9.4 modifier.

cumulative_bonus.display: As per Policy Schedule (% per year)
cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus percentage and maximum are specified in the Policy Schedule. No decrease on claim. Not available if Unlimited Sum Insured opted. Alternatively, a premium discount (Section 11.2) can be chosen instead.

restoration.note: Restore Benefit (Section 3.1h) is an optional cover. Restores Base SI unlimited times per policy year after each claim settlement; available for related and unrelated illness/injury. Cannot be combined with Endless Sum Insured in same year.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation period (number of days) is specified in the Policy Schedule. Standard coverage for same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation period (number of days) is specified in the Policy Schedule. Standard coverage for same condition.

day_care.display: All day-care (2hrs+); dialysis, chemo, angiography covered
day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered if admitted 2+ hours; also covers angiography, dialysis, radiotherapy, chemotherapy for cancer.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered under Section 3(d) up to limit in Policy Schedule; condition must continue for at least 3 continuous days.

ayush.display: Covered up to Policy Schedule limit
ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient and day-care treatment covered under Section 3(c) in AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day Care Centre.

organ_donor.note: Organ Donor expenses (Section 3.1d) are an optional Essential Cover; covers in-patient treatment expenses for harvesting organ for insured's use. Donor's pre/post-hospitalisation excluded.

ambulance.display: Optional add-on; limit per Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Road Ambulance (Section 3.1a) is an optional Essential Cover; limit per hospitalisation as per Policy Schedule. Air Ambulance (Section 3.1b) also optional. Radio Cab (Section 3.1c) also optional.

modern_treatments.note: Modern Treatments (Section 3.1e) including robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc. are an optional Essential Cover; limit as per Policy Schedule.

consumables.note: Consumables Cover (Section 3.1g) is an optional Essential Cover; covers items listed in Annexure II up to limit in Policy Schedule. Without this add-on, consumables are excluded.

global_cover.display: Optional add-on (24mo wait; emergency from day 1)
global_cover.note: Global Cover (Section 6) is an optional cover for in-patient, day-care and OPD treatment outside India. 24-month waiting period except for emergency care. Planned hospitalisation limited to listed critical illnesses. Waiting period reducible via Section 9.5 modifier.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new individual policies (except those with tenure less than 1 year).

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; credits for PED, specific waiting periods, moratorium etc. transferable.

notable_exclusions.display: Stem cell storage, artificial life maintenance, circumcision (non-medical), vaccination (except post-bite), treatment outside India (unless Global Cover opted), self-medication

optional_riders.display: Road/Air Ambulance, Organ Donor, Modern Treatments, Home Health Care, Consumables, Restore Benefit, OPD Cover, Global Cover, Critical Illness, Personal Accident, Maternity & Child Care, Endless SI, Adventure Sports, Gym & Sports Injury
